summary: A platform for a car dealership: vehicle inventory (make, model, year, price, mileage, VIN, status new/used), browse and filter listings, vehicle detail pages, customer inquiries and leads with follow-up notes, test-drive booking, financing interest form, and a sales-team dashboard showing leads and inventory. Multi-branch support with per-branch inventory.
